title: should render the series-cap notice with correct counts and route "Use Top N" to the editor
verifies: a breakdown with >100 distinct values surfaces the series-cap chip with N/M series and "Use Top N" routes to the editor with focus=top-n

title: should render the partial notice and re-run the panel on "Refresh"

title: should show the query-error icon on an erroring panel
verifies: a panel whose query errors surfaces the legacy panel-error-data warning icon
